name: cockpit-relay
description: Lets the Bridge cockpit (scripts/bridge-cockpit.py) ask this Claude Code session: heartbeats, takes the questions the cockpit signs and addresses to this session as prompts, one at a time, and writes the answers back. Works in any terminal (cmux, tmux or plain). Active only with cockpit.enabled in bridge-config.yaml and the relay not switched off; never in an agent tab.
